capabilities: Add folder-derived tags to new and moved notes
Preserve manually added tags during replacement
Clean up folder names by stripping numeric prefixes and year folders
Preview generated tags before applying rules
Run tagging and cleanup commands per note, folder, or vault
extras: README includes a full Japanese-language guide alongside the English one; it advises letting web clippers or note-creation plugins add their own initial tags and warns that a manual tag identical to a previous folder tag cannot be distinguished from a folder-derived tag.
problem: In folder-first vaults, moving or renaming a note leaves its frontmatter tags stale, and automatic tagging risks overwriting manually added tags.
summary: Folder-derived tag manager that adds frontmatter tags from note folder paths and refreshes them on move while preserving manually added tags.
